evidence.AC1: POST /todos with {"title":"past","dueDate":"2026-10-14"} returned 201 with dueDate "2026-10-14". A POST without dueDate returned 201 with dueDate null. The date is a plain YYYY-MM-DD string with no time.
evidence.AC2: PATCH /todos/4 with {"dueDate":"2026-09-01"} returned 200 and set the date. PATCH with {"dueDate":null} returned 200 and dueDate was null again. PATCH /todos/3 with {"dueDate":"2026-12-02"} returned 200 and changed it, and a later GET showed the new value.

evidence.AC4: Today is 2026-10-15 (UTC). I created todos due yesterday, today, in the future, with no date, and one due 2026-01-01 that I then marked done. GET /todos?overdue=true returned only the todo due 2026-10-14. The due-today, future, no-date and done todos were excluded.
